questions.question: The club sold 1 480 tickets on Friday and 2 365 on Saturday. Write number sentences for the total and for how many more were sold on Saturday, and solve them.
questions.expected_answer: Total: 1 480 + 2 365 = box, so the box is 3 845. How many more: 2 365 − 1 480 = box, so the box is 885.

questions.question: The club had some money, spent R3 750 and has R8 250 left. Write a number sentence with the box in the right place and find the box.
questions.expected_answer: Box − 3 750 = 8 250. The starting amount must be 8 250 + 3 750, so the box is 12 000. The club started with R12 000.

questions.question: R2 000 is raised, R560 is paid for ingredients and the rest is shared equally among 6 teams. Write one number sentence and solve it.
questions.expected_answer: (2 000 − 560) ÷ 6 = box. Brackets first: 2 000 − 560 = 1 440. Then 1 440 ÷ 6 = 240. Each team gets R240.
